status: CAD-checked print prototype; physical fit, cutting force, grip retention and fatigue untested
based_on: SO-101 v0.3 reinforced fixed root R1
SO-101 v0.3 reinforced spring locator R1

working_jaw.funnel: Preserved working funnel outline, adapted to the narrow SO wrist root

motion.spring_method: Prescribed cubic CAD shape, not FEA or an equilibrium solution

blade.bed: Fixed positive bed, back stops, notch key and integral distal fence; no blade adjustment
blade.cover_cleanup: Fragile lower flanges removed from short cover wings. Main contact lands and full-depth distal fence retained.

fasteners.added: 4 M3 x 8 socket-head screws + 4 M3 nuts (2 blade cover, 2 rear brace)
fasteners.servo_and_horn: Original SO mount and horn hardware retained; not the Maker carriage M3 x 10 pattern

checks.offset_scope: Working head only, not motor/cradle clearance
checks.exported_STLs: Valid single solids and closed reloadable meshes
checks.inherited_overlap_note: Existing source reference overlap preserved; added receiver material does not intersect the servo. This is not a full manufacturing fit guarantee.
